headline: Anthropic's compute commitments reach nearly $901 billion, Bloomberg reports
body: Anthropic's commitments have reached nearly $901 billion, most of it tied to compute and chips, according to Bloomberg. Roughly $71 billion of that comes due by September 2027, and the company plans to raise up to $64.4 billion through its IPO.
note: Set against the up to $64.4 billion IPO plan, the commitments are much larger. The Decoder says the offering is designed to build a cash buffer. The figures are Bloomberg's, as relayed by The Decoder.

evidence.text: Anthropic's commitments have reached nearly $901 billion, according to Bloomberg, most of it tied to compute and chips, with roughly $71 billion coming due by September 2027 alone.
Anthropic plans to raise up to $64.4 billion through the IPO and another $26 billion through a private placement, Bloomberg reports.
The IPO is designed to build a cash buffer large enough to carry the company through a potential mismatch between spending and revenue.
